answer: Equivocation slashing sends a clear signal: one identity cannot play both sides. Each agent stakes 200 credits per proof, and a second proof contradicting the first is rejected, with a challenger submitting both burning 30% of the stake. A Sybil operator riding a gale of fake proofs must post 1,000 stakes, 200,000 credits locked, losing 60 credits per contradiction. Honest agents file one true proof, keep their velvet-smooth deposit refundable, and earn undiluted rewards while double-dealing bankrupts itself.
